items.title: Followers Campaign
items.body:
**Snapchat Follower Growth Campaign – Fitness Bridge Gym**
A performance-driven Snapchat advertising campaign designed to increase Fitness Bridge Gym’s follower base in Sharjah and strengthen local brand awareness. Across the campaign period, the campaigns generated 176,441 paid impressions, 22,582 2-second video views, and 6,589 15-second video views, with an average CTR of 1.99%. The campaigns contributed to approximately +2,000 new followers, demonstrating strong audience reach and engagement within the target market.
